# SoPforAgents

> A public project building source-backed operating knowledge for AI agents with KL4A.

## Project status

The project is in development. No knowledge bundles are published or available to download yet.

## First domain and focus

- Domain: US healthcare operations.
- Focus: prior authorization across leading US health insurers.
- First bundle: in preparation; source selection, reuse rights, and coverage boundaries are under review.

## Planned workflow

Public SOPs, policies, and guidelines will be transformed through KL4A into versioned knowledge bundles. Users will download a bundle, inspect its source evidence and review status, extend it with their own procedures, and expose it to agents through KL4A MCP.

Source requirements and organization-approved procedures will have distinct provenance and review status. This brief describes a project in development and contains no reviewed insurer requirements.
